head: e171b4cfcff1d61e0a72df8db1a71fbf4e09bb90
scope: ephemeral macOS CI runner; disposable file under one of four owned store directories; same-user observer and child
limits: The zero-reference and zero-holder observations are for the owned child before remapping, not a complete host census. The unreadable PID count is from a same-user scan, not the separate root probe. This demonstrates a false-negative handle class and that UF_IMMUTABLE did not revoke it; it does not establish whether a root observer could enumerate Mach memory-entry rights or certify a continuous no-writer interval. A fresh read after child exit proves the shared VM object changed, not durable media persistence. No production state was touched.
